{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Display basic info
df.info()

# Check for missing values
missing_values = df.isnull().sum()

# Show first few rows
df.head(3)

# Summary statistics for flipper_length_mm
flipper_stats = df['flipper_length_mm'].describe()

# Group by species and compute mean flipper length
mean_flipper_by_species = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Output all relevant info
print("Missing values:")
print(missing_values)
print("\nSummary statistics for flipper length:")
print(flipper_stats)
print("\nMean flipper length by species:")
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

# Return the species with highest mean flipper length
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
print(f"\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species}")"}
